name: X: Export Account
summary: Export one account's posts in a date range as Markdown with media URLs, using one tab and a bounded internal scroll loop.
description: Open X search once, harvest every visible post from one handle while scrolling, expand truncated cards, enrich each post through X's authenticated read API, group same-conversation posts as threads, and return one Markdown archive plus downloadable media URLs.

steps.name: Open X in the authenticated tab

inputs.script: const c=v=>String(v==null?'':v).trim();const handle=c(arg0).replace(/^@+/,'');const since=c(arg1),until=c(arg2);if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,15}$/.test(handle))throw new Error('invalid X handle');if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(since)||!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(until))throw new Error('dates must be YYYY-MM-DD');const q='from:'+handle+' since:'+since+' until:'+until;const url='https://x.com/search?q='+encodeURIComponent(q)+'&src=typed_query&f=live';setTimeout(()=>location.assign(url),0);return {handle,since,until,url};

steps.name: Harvest, enrich, and render the archive

const clean=v=>String(v==null?'':v).trim();const handle=clean(arg0).replace(/^@+/,'');const since=clean(arg1),until=clean(arg2);const cap=Math.max(1,Math.min(1000,parseInt(clean(arg3),10)||250));const delay=Math.max(800,Math.min(5000,parseInt(clean(arg4),10)||1200));const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const uniq=a=>[...new Set(a.filter(Boolean))];const norm=s=>String(s||'').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();const found=new Map();const harvest=()=>{for(const a of document.querySelectorAll("main article[data-testid='tweet'],main article")){const link=a.querySelector("a[href*='/status/'] time")?.closest('a')||a.querySelector("a[href*='/status/']");const m=(link?.getAttribute('href')||'').match(/^/([^/]+)/status/(\d+)/);if(!m||m[1].toLowerCase()!==handle.toLowerCase())continue;const time=a.querySelector('time')?.getAttribute('datetime')||null;if(time){const day=time.slice(0,10);if(day<since||day>=until)continue;}found.set(m[2],{id:m[2],post_url:'https://x.com/'+m[1]+'/status/'+m[2],posted_at:time,dom_text:norm(a.querySelector("[data-testid='tweetText']")?.innerText||'')});if(found.size>=cap)break;}};window.scrollTo(0,0);let stale=0,last=0;for(let i=0;i<200&&found.size<cap&&stale<8;i++){document.querySelectorAll("[data-testid='tweet-text-show-more-link']").forEach(b=>{try{b.click()}catch{}});harvest();stale=found.size===last?stale+1:0;last=found.size;window.scrollBy(0,Math.max(700,Math.round(innerHeight*.85)));await sleep(delay);}harvest();const cookie=n=>document.cookie.split(';').map(x=>x.trim()).find(x=>x.startsWith(n+'='))?.slice(n.length+1)||'';const BEARER=decodeURIComponent('AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAANRILgAAAAAAnNwIzUejRCOuH5E6I8xnZz4puTs%3D1Zv7ttfk8LF81IUq16cHjhLTvJu4FA33AGWWjCpTnA');const fieldToggles={withArticleRichContentState:true,withArticlePlainText:true,withArticleSummaryText:true,withArticleVoiceOver:false,withGrokAnalyze:false,withDisallowedReplyControls:false,withPayments:false,withAuxiliaryUserLabels:false};const locate=(root,id)=>{const stack=[root],seen=new Set();while(stack.length){const x=stack.pop();if(!x||typeof x!=='object'||seen.has(x))continue;seen.add(x);const l=x.legacy;if(l&&String(x.rest_id||l.id_str||'')===id)return x;if(Array.isArray(x))stack.push(...x);else stack.push(...Object.values(x).filter(v=>v&&typeof v==='object'));}return null};const variant=v=>{const xs=(v||[]).filter(x=>/^video//.test(x.content_type||'')&&x.url).sort((a,b)=>(b.bitrate||0)-(a.bitrate||0));return xs[0]?.url||''};const fetchOne=async base=>{const variables={tweetId:base.id,withCommunity:false,includePromotedContent:false,withVoice:true};const p=new URLSearchParams({variables:JSON.stringify(variables),features:JSON.stringify(features),fieldToggles:JSON.stringify(fieldToggles)});const headers={accept:'application/json','authorization':'Bearer '+BEARER,'x-twitter-active-user':'yes','x-twitter-client-language':document.documentElement.lang||'en'};const ct0=cookie('ct0');if(ct0){headers['x-csrf-token']=ct0;headers['x-twitter-auth-type']='OAuth2Session'};try{const r=await fetch('https://api.x.com/graphql/zy39CwTyYhU-_0LP7dljjg/TweetResultByRestId?'+p,{credentials:'include',headers});if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);const t=locate(await r.json(),base.id);const l=t?.legacy||{};const media=l.extended_entities?.media||l.entities?.media||[];const images=uniq(media.filter(x=>x.type==='photo').map(x=>x.media_url_https));const videos=uniq(media.filter(x=>x.type==='video'||x.type==='animated_gif').map(x=>variant(x.video_info?.variants)));const article=t?.article?.article_results?.result||t?.article_results?.result||null;const articleText=norm(article?.plain_text||article?.content_state?.plain_text||article?.preview_text||'');return {...base,text:norm(t?.note_tweet?.note_tweet_results?.result?.text||l.full_text||base.dom_text),posted_at:l.created_at?new i=0;i<bases.length;i+=4)posts.push(...await Promise.all(bases.slice(i,i+4).map(fetchOne)));posts.sort((a,b)=>String(a.posted_at||'').localeCompare(String(b.posted_at||'')));const groups=new help.summary: Export one X account over a date range in one workflow run and one tab.

examples.command: rzn-browser run x export-account --param handle=heyblake --param since_date=2026-08-21 --param until_date=2026-09-22 --output-file ./heyblake.md --download-dir ./heyblake-assets
examples.description: Export a month of posts and media.

returns: One object containing posts, detected same-conversation threads, combined Markdown, and media URLs.
notes: Stops after eight scrolls with no new matching posts or max_posts.
X search can omit deleted, withheld, or non-indexed posts; this exports everything the authenticated search surface returns.
